en.html:
GHQ Officer"Cunning bloody bastards. Their own town, and they set fire to it before leaving."
GHQ Soldier A"Shall we withdraw, sir?"
GHQ Officer"That option is not available to us. Headquarters wants the enemy beaten unit by unit. Before they assemble, not afterwards."
GHQ Officer"Those Rokuhara troops cannot be allowed to go. Find where the fire is weakest. Break through, catch them, finish them."
GHQ Soldier A"Evacuating civilians will be in our way, sir. That contact we cannot avoid... What is the procedure then?"
GHQ Officer"Warning shots. Scatter them and make a path. If even that achieves nothing—force our way through."
GHQ Soldier A"...This is acceptable, sir? Afterwards there may be a problem..."
GHQ Officer"A problem? Of course a problem. We are firing on civilians, man. You were expecting a certificate of appreciation?"
GHQ Officer"But a choice has to be made. Are we fighting for the glory of our homeland, or for peace in this country?"
GHQ Officer"Which one?"
GHQ Soldier A"...Officially, I seem to remember we were doing the second one."
GHQ Officer"Officially. See, you do understand. Unfortunately, the army does not run on the official explanation. Reality is doing the driving."
GHQ Officer"So realistically we should behave."
GHQ Soldier A"Again and again I think, sir, my career selection was wrong. Should have become a Hollywood star. Living in everybody's dreams."
GHQ Officer"Exactly. Why didn't you, you magnificent duffer? Come. Work is waiting."
GHQ Officer"With full bravery, let us point our guns at people who have no weapons. Believing this will end the war sooner. And therefore contribute to the peace of this country also."
GHQ Soldier A"Understood."

ＧＨＱ士官「狡猾な奴らだ。 　自分の町に火をつけていくとはな」
ＧＨＱ兵士Ａ「撤退しますか、隊長？」
ＧＨＱ士官「そうもいかんだろうさ。 　敵部隊の集結を許さず各個撃破というのが 司令部の方針だ」
ＧＨＱ士官「あの六波羅どもは見逃せない。 　火勢の弱い箇所を狙って突破し捕捉、撃滅 する」
ＧＨＱ兵士Ａ「避難中の市民集団との接触は避けられない と思われますが……。 　その場合の対応は？」
ＧＨＱ士官「威嚇射撃で散らして道を作れ。 　それでも埒が明かなければ――強行突破だ」
ＧＨＱ兵士Ａ「……宜しいのですか？ 　後で問題になるのでは……」
ＧＨＱ士官「問題？　ああ、問題さ。 　民間人に発砲するんだ、問題にならない筈 があるか！」
ＧＨＱ士官「だがこいつは選択だ。 　我々は祖国の栄光のために戦うのか、それ ともこの国の平穏のために戦うのか？」
ＧＨＱ士官「どっちだ？」
ＧＨＱ兵士Ａ「……建前の上では、後者だったような気も しますがね」
ＧＨＱ士官「建前。わかってるじゃないか。 　そう、そして軍を動かすのは建前ではなく 生憎と現実・・の方だ」
ＧＨＱ士官「我々は現実的に行動すべきだろう」
ＧＨＱ兵士Ａ「常々思うんですか、自分は職業選択を間違 えたようです。 　ハリウッドスターになってみんなの夢の中 で生きていれば良かった」
ＧＨＱ士官「全くだ。なんでそうしなかった？ 　愚かな君よ、さあ仕事を始めよう」
ＧＨＱ士官「武器も持たない市民に向かって雄々しくも 銃口を突きつけるとしようじゃないか。 　こうすることで戦争は早く終わり、結果的 にこの国の平和にも寄与するのだと信じてな」
ＧＨＱ兵士Ａ「諒解」

en.html:
I looked down.
The boy was no longer moving.

A little further away, a man and a woman lay one over the other.

I knew all three faces. The family from the cafe where we had stopped on the way to Oyumi. We had dragged them into that conflict.

Were they residents of this town? Or had they come here for refuge?
Whichever it was, they had been here. And this, apparently, was the result.

Bad luck.

...As if saying those two words could put all my feelings in order.

Guilt was spilling out.
And something else also.

en.html:
The armour did not answer.
Her I had not asked.

The one I had asked did not answer either.
The power to answer was no longer with him.

The boy lay face down, not moving. Not a living human being anymore. A thing called a corpse. Of course no answer could come.

Nobody answered me.

en.html:
The question nobody was asking, I kept asking.

Why had you not run?

Why throw stones?
Why challenge him to a fight?

Because he killed your parents?
That anger, I understood.

But then you should have run all the more. Now you could not win—you knew that. Survive first. Wait for your chance to take revenge. That was the sensible thing.

Then why...
Why go straight at him like that?

Revenge alone did not explain it.

Then...
What had————

誰も訊かぬ問いを繰り返す。
　
　何故――逃げなかったのか。

　何故、石など投げたのか。
　何故、<ruby>戦いを挑んだ<rt>・・・・・・</rt></ruby>のか。

　両親を殺された怒りか。
　
　それはわかる。

　しかし、ならばむしろ逃げるべきだった。
　今は勝てないとわかっているのだから、逃げ延びて、
復讐の機を窺わねばならなかった。それが道理だ。

　なのに、何故……
　ああも真っ直ぐに挑んでしまったのか。

　復讐心だけでは説明がつかない。

　ならば……
　何が――――

en.html:
I raised one hand, cutting off the armour's metallic voice.
...That much movement, and the torn muscle in my chest started leaking blood.

Severe injury? We had crossed that place already. First all those battle wounds. Then a direct hit from Masamune's outrageous Divine Art—Return the Period. More than this body could bear.

Still, I was standing.
Limit crossed. Standing continued.

No miracle was happening here. I understood that properly.
I was running from the debt collector. Repayment postponed, that was all. Debt had not become a donation.

Bas, one more moment. I had been saying this to my body, and my body had apparently mistaken it for a repayment plan. Stand now, collapse later. Walk now, account for the legs afterwards. A thoroughly dishonest arrangement. The collector would find me with nothing left to seize but the fellow making all these promises.

How this would end was already settled.

ja.html:
片手を挙げて、俺は劒冑の<ruby>金打声<rt>こえ</rt></ruby>を遮った。
　……それだけの動作で、胸筋に入った裂傷から血が
洩れた。

　この肉体の<ruby>損傷<rt>ダメージ</rt></ruby>は既に深刻という域を超えている。
　正宗が見せたあの法外なる陰義――<ruby>陰義返し<rt>リターン・ザ・ピリオド</rt></ruby>――の
直撃、そしてそれに先立つ戦傷の蓄積は俺の耐え得る
限度以上のものをもたらしたのだ。

　それでも俺はまだ立っている。
　限度を過ぎて、なお立ち続けている。

　奇跡ではない。
　単に借金取りから逃げ回って返済を先延ばしにして
いるだけなのだと理解している。

　末路は約束されていた。
